title: Unsupported Cyclotomic Divisors in Three-Prime Integer Tilings
summary: Cyclotomic divisibility imposes strong prime-power structure on integer tiles. We study unsupported cyclotomic divisors: mixed-order divisors for which none of the prime-power components of the order divides the mask, although every prime in the order divides the tile cardinality. Kiss, Łaba, Marshall and Somlai asked whether such a phenomenon can occur in the three-prime setting. We prove that unsupported cyclotomic divisors already occur for periods with three distinct prime factors.
